identity.name: DHFR replica ensembles on one GPU: one after another, or concurrently?
identity.benchmark: OpenMM 8.2.0 examples/benchmark.py pme, fixed-work ensemble adaptation supplied in brief
identity.adaptation_status: Fixed-work dhfr_ensemble.py is supplied inline in brief, not asserted to exist in upstream repository.

outcome_definition.primary: Minimize wall time for all eight independent replicas on one GPU, preserving scientific outcomes.
outcome_definition.energy_series_limitation: Driver samples energies internally but serializes only mean and final energy; complete energy-series comparison needs additional reporting.

evidence: Public Linux x86_64 wheels exist for OpenMM 8.2.0, CPython 3.10-3.13, and OpenMM-CUDA-12 8.2.0.
CUDA plugin metadata lists NVIDIA CUDA runtime, nvcc, nvrtc, cupti and cuFFT dependencies.
Supplied brief requires a CUDA-12-compatible NVIDIA driver and one H100, A100 or A10-class GPU.
unknowns: Stock image identity, Python ABI, architecture, glibc, driver and GPU not supplied or inspected.
MPS control binary availability and container/host MPS access unverified.
CUDA execution and deterministic outcomes not reproduced.
stock_cuda_image.provisional_feasibility: Plausible on compatible stock CUDA Linux x86_64 image; no incompatibility established.

resources.input_bytes_evidence: Fetched pinned PDB (1814203 bytes), amber99sb.xml (467697 bytes), tip3p.xml (891 bytes). Excludes software installation.
resources.reason: No published or measured peak host/device working set for sequential or eight-process workload; input size alone cannot classify total.

scoring.reason: No independently published energy acceptance tolerance or fixed-work performance target. Brief predictions are hypotheses, not anchors.

repeatability.seed_usage: Same replica seed for initial velocities and integrator RNG.
repeatability.comparison_conditions: Same GPU model/device, software, precision, force properties, inputs and per-replica seeds.
repeatability.documented_guarantee: DeterministicForces documents force reproducibility; full trajectory equivalence under process scheduling remains untested.
repeatability.reason: Brief specifies no fixed repetition count or numerical run-to-run variation threshold.
repeatability.forbidden_inference: CPU smoke tests and brief speedup predictions are not independent published anchors.
